SFVBC Saturday Club Ride

Los Angeles, CA · Northridge (San Fernando Valley) · Road

Beginner friendly

SFVBC Saturday Club Ride is a road group ride in Los Angeles, CA. It rolls saturdays and Sundays at 8:00 am from CSUN Parking Lot B1. Pace: ride levels 1–5; beginner no-drop ride the first Saturday of the month.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: ride levels 1–5; beginner no-drop ride the first Saturday of the month. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the SFVBC Saturday Club Ride group ride

A 400-member road club that posts a different ride every Saturday and Sunday from the CSUN lot. Rides are rated 1 to 5 for distance and climbing. The first Saturday of each month is a beginner, no-drop ride. Helmets required; minors with a parent.
